title: HustleBox v1.3.1 — Voices & Polish
message:
Polish pass on v1.3.0's dynamics.

MALE / FEMALE VOICES
Customers now have a gender and the TTS voice matches. The browser's voices are auto-classified into male / female / neutral pools by name detection. If the device doesn't have many gendered voices, a pitch bias kicks in so the same fallback voice still reads as masculine or feminine. The customer's face emoji also matches now — men get 👨/👴/🧔, women get 👩/👵/🧕, with a small neutral pool for everyone else.

VOICE CONSISTENCY ACROSS LINES
The same customer keeps the same voice across their order line AND their personality chatter lines. Talkers no longer sound like three different people while you assemble their order. Same goes for the eavesdrop scene — Ray, Sal, and Marcus each have a stable voice every time you listen.

GRACEFUL VOICE FADE ON SHIFT END
Ending a shift used to hard-cancel the customer's voice mid-syllable. Now it pauses then cancels with a short delay — softer, less jarring. Honest note: the Web Speech API doesn't allow mid-utterance volume fades, so this is the best the browser permits. SFX and ambience use real audio gain fades.

ANTI-CHEAT ON END SHIFT
You can't just serve one customer and immediately end your shift for a quick payday. End Shift now requires at least 3 customers OR 90 seconds of shift time, whichever comes first. The button visually dims and shows a countdown like "End Shift (2 more)" or "End Shift (45s)" until you've earned it. Tapping it early shows a toast: "Ray expects more work."

BACK ROOM DOOR → WORK
The wooden door in the Back Room scene is now tappable. Click it to leave the basement and return to the food truck. Hovering shows an EXIT label and a warm glow on the door so you can see it's interactive.

No save data wiped.

entries.title: Voices & Polish
highlights: Male / female / neutral voice pools auto-detected from browser TTS voices
Each customer gets a gender; the face emoji matches (👨/👴 for male, 👩/👵 for female)
Same customer keeps the same voice across order line and chatter lines
Eavesdrop characters (Ray/Sal/Marcus) each have a consistent voice
Pitch bias on fallback voices so male/female still sounds male/female if the OS lacks gendered voices
Graceful voice pause-then-cancel on End Shift instead of abrupt cutoff
Anti-cheat: End Shift requires 3+ customers OR 90+ seconds (button dims + counter until ready)
Back Room wooden door is tappable — exits to the Work tab with hover glow + EXIT label
